_comment: HONE Verified Inference Set (VIS). Signed, versioned allowlist of engine+model pairs eligible for the VERIFIED, slashable inference marketplace tier. This does NOT override operator sovereignty on the open tier (docs/MODEL_REGISTRY_PROTOCOL.md): operators still run anything locally. Membership here only means: a node may EARN VERIFIED inference rewards serving these, because every node agrees on the exact engine+weights so denier re-execution can compare outputs. Nothing here is a default; nothing auto-downloads; the operator opts in per node. weights_sha256 = the on-chain key and the whole point of 'permissioned + versioned' — it is filled at INGESTION (fetch the exact GGUF, hash it), never fabricated. A set version is only valid once Shin signs it over the fully-populated hashes.

engine.note: Embedded candle GGUF backend (inference_engine::chat). Verified-tier output is produced by this engine at a pinned semver + binary_hash; those pins are added when the engine build is cut. Sampling is SEEDED (not greedy) per the verification design — determinism-of-seed, not determinism-of-token.

signing.signature: PENDING — set is unsigned until hashes are populated and Shin signs this exact version
signing.rule: Additive, Shin-gated. Adding a model bumps set_version and requires a fresh signature over the full model list including weights_sha256. Removing/downgrading a model also bumps + re-signs. No agent may sign or bump this set.

tiers.flagship: 24GB-class primary earners (RTX 3090/4090). The three you named.
tiers.standard: 12-16GB-class. Solid general/tool work on mid cards.
tiers.micro: CPU / edge / <=4GB. Availability tier, not throughput.
